quote:
You carry a weight that no one sees. 
Every hidden tear shapes the soul inside. 
You smile through days that drain your light. 
People only notice the mask you wear. 
They never ask what lingers underneath the surface. 
You keep surviving battles fought all alone. 
One day, your weary heart will finally rest.
